answer.reason: The World Bank WDI indicator SP.RUR.TOTL.ZS for Ethiopia (ETH) in 2023 is approximately 76.94%, which corresponds to an urban population share of about 23.06%. The alternative value, 78.93%, reflects Ethiopia's rural share in an earlier year (around 2020), not 2023, since Ethiopia's rural share has been steadily declining as urbanization increases.
